main_variable: Within every trial and FFT-isolated band, subtract each channel mean and divide by that channel's own sample standard deviation (ddof=1), then form the 18x18 correlation matrix. All later E36 shrinkage/logm/upper-triangle/detrend/zband operations are unchanged.

test_gates.reason: CNN-only attack is not full-chain adaptive evidence even if clean gates pass

evidence_boundary: Train session1 pseudo-unknown subjects and continuous within-session blocks only; not cross-session or official Test truth evidence
attack_boundary: CNN-only white-box PGD20-style transfer through the decision chain, not a full-chain adaptive attack; no E65 adversarial training

environment.compute: raw/features/WCCN/attacks on CUDA; MAT I/O and metrics on CPU

final20_train.fit: all 20 Train subjects <=60% only; E64 CNN encoders/prototypes unchanged
